## Verdict
**REWORK — changeset-only patch round.** The code change, the ratchet, and the tests are correct and stand as-is; the changeset level (`patch`) does not match the measured published-face delta, and its consequence paragraph under-states what moves. One file to fix, then re-pin CI on the new head.

## Head reviewed
`2fb8993215ed404847ba821610749e33c4206bc8` — matches the prefix; head did not move. 1 commit, 4 files, base `main` (merge-base `4e3a4f07e`; `origin/main` now `348725a7`, `mergeable_state: clean`). Draft, first line `Fixes #8576` — correct: the card is fully resolved (direction 1 executed, ledger line removed), so auto-close on merge is right. No reviews on the PR.

## Clause-② reading + claim match + `--pair` exit
- **Correct reading: `yes`.** `KbdGroup` is an exported member of published `@object-ui/components` (`src/custom/index.ts:14` → `src/index.ts:91` → `dist/index.d.ts`); its published props type changes element type parameter, and the derived `React.ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>` moves `HTMLDivElement → HTMLElement` (measured, below). Not the mechanical floor (no new export/key) — the conservative branch applies.
- **Claim: `yes` on both carriers** — PR body "Clause-②" section, and the fixed-spelling line appended to the claim comment (issue comment `5607869810`, PM pre-authorised the PATCH). Matches.
- `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 8891` → **exit 0** (both carriers agree, no widening tell).

## Governed surface
`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 4 changed paths → **NOT GOVERNED** (exit 0). Ordinary merge-queue route.

## CI on head
33 check-runs on `2fb89932`, all `completed`: 30 `success`, 3 `skipped` by design (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard)`, `dependabot`). `Lint` = success, `Type Check` = success (this is the job that compiles `tsconfig.test.json`, i.e. the type pins). No red ⇒ no causation needed.

## Findings

**F1 — Changeset level `patch` is wrong; must be `minor` with the breaking consequence stated (REWORK).**
`.changeset/kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.md:2` declares `patch` and lines 18–23 claim "everything that type-checked before still type-checks … the deprecated `align` … is the only shape that moves." I measured this independently in a scratchpad program with the tree's exact toolchain (typescript@6.0.3 / @types/react@19.2.18, per `pnpm-lock.yaml:10699` / `:5925`), mirroring the before/after declarations:
- All eight of the dev's legs reproduce (div≠kbd; div=p control; div-props ⊂ kbd-props and not reverse; `keyof` identical; `Exclude<keyof HTMLDivElement, keyof HTMLElement>` = `'align'`; div-typed `RefObject` and ref callback accepted).
- **But** `React.ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>` moves from `HTMLDivElement` to `HTMLElement` — a published derived type the PR body and changeset never name — and four consumer shapes that compile against the old declaration fail against the new one:
  - `onClick={e => e.currentTarget.align}` → TS2339 (the one the changeset names).
  - Wrapper forwarding `React.ComponentProps<typeof KbdGroup>` onto a real `<div {...p} />` → TS2322 on `ref` (`RefObject<HTMLElement|null>` not assignable to `RefObject<HTMLDivElement|null>`).
  - `useRef<React.ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>>` then reading `.current.align` → TS2339.
  - Passing `ref.current` (typed via `ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>`) to an `HTMLDivElement`-typed sink → TS2345.

  The last two do not depend on the consumer touching `align` — they break on the instance type. So "nothing that compiled stops compiling" is false as stated. The props *input* set widens (correct), but the published `.d.ts`'s derived read-side types narrow to the supertype. Per AGENTS.md:240 (objectui's own breaking changes are `minor` with the semantics in the body, never `major`) and this package's own precedent (`packages/components/CHANGELOG.md:434` / `:481` — "Breaking for TypeScript authors … marked `minor`", PR #4651; `:280`), the level is **`minor`**. This also answers the dev's `open_questions[0]`: **option B**, not A — the sibling #8571 precedent does not transfer because there the types were identical (the card itself says so).

  Required: `'@object-ui/components': minor`; restate the consequence in FROM→TO form — `ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>`: `HTMLDivElement` → `HTMLElement`; handlers' `currentTarget` likewise; call sites passing `HTMLDivElement`-typed refs and all prop names keep compiling; code that hands the ref instance to an `HTMLDivElement`-typed sink or forwards `ComponentProps<typeof KbdGroup>` onto a `div` stops compiling. The same over-claim sits in the PR body ("Premise P1", bullet 2) and the new test's docblock ("Why this cannot break a caller", `kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.test.tsx:56-66`); fix the docblock in the same patch round (prose only — the pins beneath it are correct).

**F2 — Published-face delta (for the record; correct).** `packages/components/src/custom/kbd.tsx:26`: `React.ComponentProps<"div">` → `React.ComponentProps<"kbd">`. Emitted by vite-plugin-dts per-file (`packages/components/vite.config.ts:36-59`, `insertTypesEntry`, no `rollupTypes`) into `dist/custom/kbd.d.ts` and reached from `dist/index.d.ts` (`package.json` `types`/`exports`). Props dropped/added by name: **none** (`keyof` identical). Element type parameter: `HTMLDivElement → HTMLElement` (`ref`, all `currentTarget`s, `ComponentRef`). Rendered element `kbd.tsx:28` `<kbd data-slot="kbd-group">` — **unchanged**, DOM-pinned.

**F3 — Correctness vs the card: correct.** Direction 1 (type follows element) as the dispatch ruled; `kbd`-grouping-`kbd`s is legal HTML and is upstream shadcn's shape. Ledger line removed in the same PR (`empty-description-…-8571.test.tsx:182-187`); the ratchet order is deterministic from the test code (with the line gone and `"div"` still declared, `disagreeing` = `{'kbd.tsx:KbdGroup': 'div -> kbd'} ≠ {}` fails by that test name), and the shards are green with the ledger empty. Census verified on `origin/main` with `git grep -w KbdGroup`: definition, `export`, ledger line only — zero call sites in objectui; zero in `/home/user/objectstack`; no `cloud` checkout present. `custom/kbd.tsx` is **not** sync-regenerated (`scripts/shadcn-sync.js:42` `COMPONENTS_DIR = src/ui`; `shadcn-components.json:430` lists `kbd` as "Custom ObjectUI component"), so the No-Touch rule does not apply and the fix will not be overwritten.

**F4 — Scope: clean.** 4 files, all card-related; no `content/docs/releases/`; no governed path; no adjacent fixes. The `renderers/data-display/kbd.tsx` div-vs-kbd observation was correctly left unfiled in 验收备注.

**F5 — Tests: pin the contract with the required controls.** `kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.test.tsx:105-133`: `Equal<GroupProps, KbdProps>` identity, refused-by-name `div`, refused intersection caricature, `IsAny` control, sibling `Kbd` control, `keyof` equality, and a `@ts-expect-error` on `nonsenseProp` that goes unused (TS2578) under the `any` caricature; `:140-152` ref-assignability pins plus runtime `divTypedRef.current.tagName === 'KBD'`; `:83-101` DOM `tagName` pin. Compiled by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (chained by `type-check`, CI `Type Check` green) and run by vitest (shards green). Positive control present (`div` vs `p` in the same program). Optional, not required: a one-line `Assert<Equal<React.ComponentRef<typeof KbdGroup>, HTMLElement>>` would pin the derived type that F1 turns on.

**F6 — Docs: nothing to change.** No `content/docs`, README, or example mentions `KbdGroup` (`kbd.mdx` documents the SDUI schema renderer, a different module). `README Export Check` green on head. The changeset is the release-notes input, hence F1 matters.

**F7 — Report hygiene (note only, not REWORK).** `check:readme-exports` honestly reported NOT MEASURED locally (prerequisite unmet); CI's `README Export Check` is green on head, so the reading is covered. `mcp_calls: 0`, census via git — as the checklist prefers.
